settings.heading: Before you *join*
settings.text: Anything not here, write to us and you hear back within a working day.

settings.question: Do I need expensive gear?
settings.answer: No. A USB microphone and a quiet room are enough. Week three has a shopping list at three budgets, the cheapest is about $150.

settings.question: How much time does it take?
settings.answer: About three hours a week: two short lessons, recording one episode and the Thursday call if you can make it.

settings.question: Audio only, or video too?
settings.answer: Both are covered. The lessons start with audio, and one module shows how to film the same conversation for YouTube.

settings.question: Do I need an audience first?
settings.answer: No. Week seven covers your first listeners: people you already know, guests who share their episode, and one place to post each week.

settings.question: When does the next round start?
settings.answer: On the first Monday of each month. Change this to your own dates.

settings.question: Can I get a refund?
settings.answer: Yes. Write within 30 days of joining, for any reason, and you get your money back.

settings.question: Is it live or recorded?
settings.answer: Lessons are recorded, so you watch when it suits you. The Thursday calls are live and the recording is up the same day.

settings.question: What software do I need?
settings.answer: A free recording app and a free editor. The lessons use free tools only, and show where a paid one saves time.

settings.question: Can I join from any time zone?
settings.answer: Yes. Calls are at a set time and recorded, and you can send questions in before the call.
